hook_text: 12² is not 24. Here is the picture that fixes it forever.
clip_script: A square number is a number multiplied by itself. Twelve squared means twelve times twelve, which is 144. The name comes from geometry: 144 tiles can be laid out as a perfect square, twelve tiles along each side. The square root undoes squaring. The square root of 144 is twelve. A common error is to confuse squaring with doubling. Twelve squared is 144, not twenty-four.
visual_style: Tiles snap into a 12 by 12 square that fills the screen next to a tiny strip of 24 tiles; then blocks stack into a 6 by 6 by 6 cube.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson for cubes, cube roots and mental tricks.
